Description
CEU San Pablo University is a private University belonging to the University Group CEU (CEU Universities), the first private educational group in Spain by number of students and the second for quality of their studies (Ranking The Higher Education - 2020). The institution began his studies in 1933. All his study programs are official and recognized in the European Higher Education Area. It is a recognized University in numerous areas of study. It has Faculties of Medicine, Pharmacy, Law and Economics, Communication, Humanities and Education and Psychology, adding more than 100 Bachelor's degrees, more than 50 programs of Official master's degree and have an important doctoral school. The University stands out for being the benchmark in the application of CEU values: Quality training, continuous support of students in teaching, orientation career and international dimension, which is manifested in the high number of international students in their classrooms.
